message: Relation field "Post.author": @relation argument "onDelete" is not supported; Prisma 8 enforces no referential actions on MongoDB. Remove "onDelete" and handle related documents in application code.

Relation field "Comment.author": @relation argument "onUpdate" is not supported; Prisma 8 enforces no referential actions on MongoDB. Remove "onUpdate" and handle related documents in application code.
Relation field "Like.user": @relation argument "map" is not supported; it names a foreign key constraint, and MongoDB has none. Remove "map".
